name: 0000-MAIN
description: This paragraph initializes the execution environment, processes accounts receivable data in a loop, and performs cleanup before ending the program.

algorithm.details: Opens an accounts receivable file for reading or writing.
Transfers control to 1000-LOOP to process data until a condition is met.
Ends the program execution with a GOBACK statement.

sideEffects.description: Updates the file with processed data.
